description: The Walloon Roof Material spectral library contains measurements of 26 roofing materials used in Wallonia, Belgium. The CASMATTELE project, with the Institut Scientifique de Service Public, produced the library to describe regional construction materials for remote-sensing applications. Measurements span 350–2,500 nanometres at one-nanometre sampling intervals and combine laboratory and field observations made with an ASD FieldSpec3 Hi-Res spectrometer. Zenodo provides an archive of the spectral library. The repository explicitly assigns CC BY-NC-SA 1.0, so access is free while commercial reuse is restricted. The metadata does not establish a continuous observation period. Regional material selection limits transfer to other building stocks. The spectra could support roof-material classification before assigning building properties in exposure or urban simulations. No directly related catalogue record was found.
